high_level_description: This image captures a view from inside a modern building, looking out through a large glass window onto an urban street scene. The setting appears to be a commercial area with tall, sleek skyscrapers reflecting the sky and surrounding buildings. The architecture of the buildings is contemporary, featuring glass facades and geometric designs. Inside the building, there is a no-smoking sign prominently displayed on the right side of the window. The sign is bilingual, written in both Arabic ("ممنوع التدخين") and English ("No Smoking"), accompanied by a graphic of a crossed-out cigarette.
